model.name: RbTraceTree.buildSeedNode impl
model.description: BUILT v0.7.95: R31.3 N-level layer-by-layer tree in the SHARED rb-trace-tree. (a) recursive TreeNode type at every depth; per-node chevron = hasChildren||children.length>0 so WINDOW nodes are first-class expandable. (b) killed the eager :339 grandchild recursion — buildSeedNode now STORES inline children + builds ONLY the direct layer, lazily on first open (buildDirectLayer), each child collapsed with its own chevron → N levels reveal one layer per expand (no explode-then-settle). (c) per-level initial open = data-always-expanded||shouldStartOpen||persisted-expanded; renderItems no longer force-opens roots; PATH-A passes child.children (windows keep panes on re-render). Backward-compat: API-backed nodes (no inline children, hasChildren:true) still lazy-fetch on open → /trace 2-level trees render+expand unchanged. Marker [impl:uuid:5b3d9f1a-...] on the buildSeedNode decl. R31.3.
